name: Lower Amazon fishing-community pottery
description: A shell midden near Santarém preserves pottery from a site described as an early fishing village.

date.label: Approximately 8000–7000 years BP
date.basis: Rounded conversion using BP=1950; the abstract describes site dates, not a precise manufacture interval. Radiocarbon results are reported as calibrated; the thermoluminescence result is a separate dating method.

events.statement: The abstract reports calibrated radiocarbon dates and a thermoluminescence date from the site spanning approximately 8000–7000 years BP.

earliest_record.rationale: Reported range; no current global-priority claim.

caveats: Abstract-only review. Individual sample associations, calibration details, stratigraphy and actual vessel use await full-text review.

unresolved.note: The inspected abstract does not settle independent invention versus transmission.

research.note: Independent review checked the published abstract: its dates are for site samples, while a particular use of the pottery is not established there.
